scope: ordinary insect bite or sting without any airway, mouth, or systemic allergic symptoms
response: Wash the area and use a cold pack wrapped in cloth for comfort. If a bee stinger is visible, gently scrape it sideways away with a card rather than squeezing it. A pharmacist can advise on suitable itch-relief products.
red_flags: trouble breathing, wheezing, or a hoarse voice
swelling of the lips, tongue, mouth, or throat
widespread hives, faintness, or repeated vomiting
multiple stings or a sting inside the mouth or throat
spreading redness, warmth, or fever a day or two later
